description: a gentle man saint with short dark brown hair and a short beard, a thin golden halo ring behind the head, pure white robes with fine golden embroidery, a long pale gold mantle, a golden sash, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the halo to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, headwear, clothes, armour, colours and drawing style; leave out the staff: the hands are empty
the character's look in detail: face, hair, clothes and colours; the hands empty, without the staff
